checked_content: Visually checked the strong finite-flat-family hope and the editorial footnote crediting an unpublished Artin counterexample already for smooth proper curve fibres of genus g>=2. This is an exact negative fate for the strong hope, not for every Nori homotopy theorem.
Read introductory account of Saint-Donat cohomological descent and Deligne additions in XVII/XVIII. Context only, not a proof check of the manuscript duality claims.

Read the explanation that the original I–V were not written and were summarized in the newly redacted Expose I; introduction dated Bures May1972. Draft numbering cannot automatically be matched to final numbering.

Read tame inertia action and arithmetic/geometric quasi-unipotence statements. Proposition1.1 refers to the Serre–Tate Appendix. These sources support the finite-spectrum argument but published I6.5 is a different assertion.
Read abelian-reduction context and identified bibliography reference5 Serre–Tate1968. Lemma numbering6.5 here is not the cancelled manuscript conjugation lemma.
